class Analyzer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.maxLength = 0
        self.countLength = 0
        self.countWord = 0
        self.checker = 0
        self.checkerInside = 0
        self.isInWordOut = False
        self.isInWordIn = False
        self.isInside = False

    def feed(self, c):
        if c == '(':
            self.isInside = True
            self.checkerInside += 1
            if self.maxLength < self.countLength:
                self.maxLength = self.countLength
            self.countLength = 0
            self.isInWordOut = False
        elif c == ')':
            self.isInside = False
            self.checkerInside = 0
            if self.checker > 0:
                self.countWord += 1
                self.checker = 0
        else:
            if self.checkerInside > 0:
                self.isInside = True
            if not self.isInside:
                if c == '_':
                    if self.maxLength < self.countLength:
                        self.maxLength = self.countLength
                    self.countLength = 0
                    self.isInWordOut = False
                else:
                    self.isInWordOut = True
                if self.isInWordOut:
                    self.countLength += 1
            else:
                self.isInWordOut = False
                if c == '_':
                    if self.checker > 0:
                        self.countWord += 1
                    self.checker = 0
                    self.isInWordIn = False
                else:
                    self.isInWordIn = True
                if self.isInWordIn:
                    self.checker += 1

    def result(self):
        if self.maxLength < self.countLength:
            self.maxLength = self.countLength
        return f"{self.maxLength} {self.countWord}"

def main():
    length = int(input())
    s = input()
    analyzer = Analyzer()
    for ch in s:
        analyzer.feed(ch)
    print(analyzer.result())

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
